title: tragacantha falconeri
intro: Tragacantha falconeri, commonly known as Indian thistle, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha falconeri include reducing inflammation, preventing infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
